messages:
tom_sales: GammaApps procurement flagged a deal blocker — their chargeback requires charges to be split by department code (dept-ops / dept-ai). Their system matches by SKU label. They want the commit discount applied across both departments if combined spend hits the tier.
raj_dealdesk: Noted. Marketplace metering is usually SKU (offer+sku) level. If they split into two internal SKUs we won't automatically attribute both to a single commit unless the offer supports multiple SKUs with a shared commit.
liz_finops: Important: their CFO will only release a PO that maps to internal cost centers. They can't change templates before month close. If we accept a single marketplace SKU but they push it into two cost centers, our metering may not allocate correctly.
nina_pm: Product question — can we publish a second SKU under the same offer id that maps to a department dimension, or add usage-dimension tags so marketplace metering aggregates?
marketplace-bot: FYI: AWS marketplace supports multiple sku entries under the same offer but billing aggregation rules are provider-specific. Azure/GC may support usage dimensions. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/metering-config (access required).aj_dealdesk: Options: (A) Provision two SKUs (dept-ops, dept-ai) on a Private Offer with committed volumes tied to the combined commit, (B) Accept customer's consolidated PO referencing their internal labels and perform manual allocation/crediting in our billing system, (C) Delay start until marketplace-side mapping is updated. Each option needs approvals.
liz_finops: Finance prefers Private Offer for clean audit trail, but understands lead time. If timeline forces manual allocation we need: signed acknowledgment from the buyer, GL codes for allocation, and a 45-day credit window cap.
tom_sales: Customer wants to start POC tomorrow and won't wait 72h for Private Offer. They asked if we can accept their PO as-is with a guarantee the commit will be applied across both departments.
henry_partner: Partner ops: Creating a Private Offer with two SKUs requires product config + partner enable + partner marketplace review — estimate 48-72h once deal desk approves. There's also a partner fee flow.
raj_dealdesk: Drafting exception language for manual allocation: "Redwood will accept PO referencing customer internal cost center labels and will manually attribute charges to the agreed SKUs for the period Apr 2026. Any failure of marketplace metering to map charges will be corrected via a one-time credit, up to a cap of $XX,XXX, within 45 days following invoice." Need legal + finance sign-off.
liz_finops: GL codes: SALES_RECUR_DEPT for revenue, CREDIT_MANUAL_RETRO for credits. Accounting requires copy of signed buyer acknowledgment before issuing credits.
nina_pm: For accounting, here's mapping snippet to include in notes:
```
- offer_id: offer_aws_gammaapps_01
- sku_dept_ops: redwood.marketplace.gamma.ops
- sku_dept_ai: redwood.marketplace.gamma.ai
- customer_label_ops: "GammaApps - Ops"
- customer_label_ai: "GammaApps - AI"
- combined_commit: 500k/month (applies across both SKUs)
```
raj_dealdesk: Circulating to legal now. If legal pushes back we escalate to Private Offer flow. Legal probable asks: limit credit window, require signed ack, cap credits, and retain right to audit usage before credit.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Private Offer creation will lock current ratecard for that offer when provisioned; any later ratecard changes may require amendment.
liz_finops: Finance OK on conditional manual allocation if buyer signs ack and we insert the audit/cap language. Accounting will raise a deferred revenue check for the commit.
tom_sales: Customer agreed to sign the acknowledgement immediately if we accept PO today. I've requested the signed doc and will attach here.
raj_dealdesk: Final: deal desk approves one-time manual allocation exception pending legal sign-off and receipt of signed buyer ack. Action items: 1) raj_dealdesk send exception draft to legal (in progress), 2) liz_finops confirm GL codes and credit cap (pending), 3) nina_pm prepare SKU mapping and prod notes, 4) tom_sales obtain signed ack and PO and hold start until legal greenlight.
henry_partner: I'll queue Private Offer path in parallel in case legal declines, but we'll prioritize the customer's timeline per deal desk.
raj_dealdesk: Logging resolution in Salesforce and deal notes now. Will update thread when legal replies.
tom_sales: thanks team — ping here as soon as legal sends ok. :pray:
